The US Open mixed doubles championship qualifying rounds, semifinals, and finals are August 25-26. ESPN2 will air the qualifying and semifinal matches while ESPN will air the final.

Roger Federer returns to New York on August 25 for an exhibition airing from 8-10 pm on ESPN. (Federer will be inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame on August 29.) [...] Tennis Channel will have select qualifying matches, fan week festivities, and beginning and end-of-day highlights and analysis throughout the tournament.
